paragraphs: i grew up on the internet.
i love cyberpunk. neon skylines. machines that feel alive. questions about consciousness and scale.
dune changed how i think about power and destiny.
the three-body problem rewired my sense of cosmic insignificance.
i’m probably the way i am because i watched tron when i was 12 and decided the future had to glow.
i studied electronics for six years at a nowhere college. oscilloscopes, solder burns, broken circuits. that’s where i learned pattern recognition. signal from noise. systems thinking.
i love retro tech. old processors. chunky keyboards. green terminal screens.
i’m in pursuit of greatness.not the loud kind.the disciplined, inevitable kind.
